summary: AgencyWebsites is a user control for managing and displaying agency websites in the system. It provides CRUD (create, read, update, delete) functionality for agency website records, visible and editable within a GridView interface. The control supports addition, modification, and deletion of website entries, and displays empty data prompts if no websites are present and the screen is editable.
purpose: To allow authorized users to manage the list of websites associated with an agency, including adding, editing, and deleting website information (such as URL, name, and comments).

workflows.name: Agency Website Management
steps: If no websites exist and screen is editable, user is prompted to add.
User can initiate add, edit, or delete via GridView row commands.
On add/edit, FormView collects URL, Name, Comment.
After any change, view is redirected and refreshed.

business_rules: Only authorized users may edit or delete website records.
Addition of website requires URL and Name fields.
Updated records are reflected immediately after action and redirection.
If no websites exist but editable, prompt add action.
validations: URL must be a valid web address.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable controls whether user may make changes or just view.
If user is not authorized or session is absent, actions are cancelled.
system_behavior: GridView populates with agency websites and supports paging.
Empty data panel provides add button if editable and no records exist.
FormView is used for editing and adding website details.
Redirect on change ensures cached session and correct navigation with read-only or editable flags.
dependencies: Websites data access methods (AgencyWebsiteAdd, AgencyWebsiteUpdate, AgencyWebsiteDelete)
exceptions: Attempt to edit or add with missing/invalid fields results in validation failure.
content_gaps: No explicit error handling behavior for backend exceptions.
No detail on Website model validation beyond control-level checks.
No explicit details on GridView column configuration.
